Name: summary
Values: This dataset contains observations to support further understanding of metocean conditions off the coast of Virginia. Data is collected from a wave rider buoy and the dataset includes  measurements of wave peak height, wave significant height,  wave peak direction, and wave significant period.
Name Definition/Suggested value: Basic summary of dataset - location, platform, variables collected.
Example: This dataset contains observations to support further understanding of metocean conditions off the coast of New York, Rhode Island and Southeastern Massachusetts. Data is collected from a floating lidar buoy and the dataset includes  measurements of sea temperature (surface and sea floor), current speed, current direction, wave height, wave direction, and wave period, air temperature, atmospheric pressure, relative humidity, visibility, surface wind speed,  surface wind direction, and surface wind gust.
